signatureEngine.name: 比格气缸
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 万斤顶
refinements.description: 受到的伤害降低7.5%；受到敌方攻击后，下一次攻击命中敌人时，额外造成装备者600%防御力的伤害，且必定触发暴击，7.5秒内最多触发一次。
refinements.descriptionEn: Reduces DMG taken by 7.5%. After being attacked, the next attack to hit an enemy will trigger a critical hit and deal 600% of the equipper's DEF as additional DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 7.5s.

refinements.name: 万斤顶

refinements.descriptionEn: Reduces DMG taken by 8.5%. After being attacked, the next attack to hit an enemy will trigger a critical hit and deal 690% of the equipper's DEF as additional DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 7.5s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：对账
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：拳债统计
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
架起武器格挡敌人的攻击，随后对前方进行打击，造成物理伤害，若在格挡期间成功格挡敌人的攻击，将提升招式的威力，发动格挡反击，造成大量物理伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 能够维持格挡；
维持格挡时获得护盾，护盾值随时间衰减；
退出格挡后移除护盾，护盾值随时间回复；
护盾值最高不超过本生命值上限的16%；
格挡发动时拥有无敌效果；
打击发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attack before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Physical DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while launching strikes.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：到期还拳
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
架起武器格挡敌人的攻击，随后对前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害，若在格挡期间成功格挡敌人的攻击，将提升招式的威力，发动格挡反击，造成大量火属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 能够维持格挡；
维持格挡时获得护盾，护盾值随时间衰减；
退出格挡后移除护盾，护盾值随时间回复；
护盾值最高不超过本生命值上限的16%；
招式发动时，回复护盾至最大值；
招式发动后，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 ，能够向前方追加强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
格挡发动时拥有无敌效果；
打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attacks before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Fire DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value.
After activating the skill, press [EX Special Attack] again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Ben is invulnerable while launching strikes.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：清算
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：盖章，结算
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：拳债，全面清偿
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，额外回复3点支援点数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When activating the skill, additionally recover 3 Assist Points.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：联合追债
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：分摊风险
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：违约惩罚
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
本的初始攻击力随初始防御力提升，提升效果等同于自身初始防御力的80%；
在[强化特殊技]中追加强力打击时，为全队角色提供等同于自身30%防御力+550点护盾，持续30秒。
facts.textEn:
Ben's initial ATK increases along with his initial DEF. He gains 80% of his initial DEF as ATK.
When Ben launches a powerful follow-up strike during his EX Special Attack, all squad members gain a Shield of 30% of his DEF +550, lasting for 30s.

cinema.name: 反作用力
cinema.description: 发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]，成功格挡敌人的攻击时，攻击者造成的伤害降低30%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.

cinema.name: 以守为攻
cinema.description: 在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中，成功触发格挡反击时，额外造成本300%防御力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully triggering a Block Counter during Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, inflict an additional 300% of Ben's DEF as DMG.

cinema.name: 精打细算
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 灵活应变
cinema.description: 在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中，通过无敌效果成功格挡攻击时 ，后继反击造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully blocking enemy DMG with Ben's invulnerable effect during his Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the following counter deals 30% more DMG.

cinema.name: 巨细靡遗
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 野性斗志
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]中发动攻击或追加强力打击后，[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]造成的失衡值提升20%，持续12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: After launching an attack or follow-up attack during Ben's EX Special Attack, Daze inflicted by Basic Attacks, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter is increased by 20%, lasting 12s.
